# Data Source: identitynow_connector_rule

Use this data source to look up a connector rule by ID or name. Lookups by name list all connector rules and match the name exactly.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "identitynow_connector_rule" "before_create" {
  name = "AD Before Create"
}
```

Exactly one of `id` and `name` must be set.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Connector rule ID. Exactly one of `id` or `name` must be set.
- `name` (String) Rule name. Exactly one of `id` or `name` must be set.

### Read-Only

- `attributes_json` (String) Rule attributes as a JSON object.
- `created` (String) Creation date.
- `description` (String) Description of the rule's purpose.
- `modified` (String) Last modification date.
- `signature_json` (String) Function signature of the rule as a JSON object.
- `source_code` (Attributes List) Code of the rule, a list with one element. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--source_code))
- `type` (String) Rule type.

<a id="nestedatt--source_code"></a>
### Nested Schema for `source_code`

Read-Only:

- `script` (String) The BeanShell code.
- `version` (String) Version of the code.
